llm_response.reason: The website displays significant scam indicators: it heavily advertises unusually large discounts (30–50%) for NOBULL products (Characteristic 1), mimics the structure of a legitimate branded e-commerce site (Characteristic 16), and lacks transparent company details or appropriate business contact info (Characteristics 4 and 6). The WHOIS data reveals the domain was only registered on 2025-07-27 and is fully anonymized through a privacy-proxy, strongly associated with scam operations. These signs, combined with a lack of credible business footprint online, support the conclusion that this is a fake shopping scam site.
